mapper.select: SELECT id, family_id, baby_id, vaccine_name, dose_no, due_date, planned_date, status, skip_reason, record_id, manual, created_by, deleted FROM baby_vaccine_plan WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND baby_id = #{babyId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(planned_date, due_date), id
mapper.update: UPDATE baby_vaccine_plan SET due_date = #{plan.dueDate}, planned_date = #{plan.plannedDate}, status = #{plan.status}, skip_reason = #{plan.skipReason}, record_id = #{plan.recordId}, manual = #{plan.manual} WHERE id = #{plan.id} AND deleted = 0
